title: Reversibility-class ledger and irreversible-action authority embargo
hypothesis: A claim-specific decision contract can classify proposed actions by reversibility and must embargo irreversible or externally consequential actions whenever exact authority, rollback evidence, competent review, or required external evidence is absent.
falsifier: Mutate action class, external-state flag, rollback evidence, blast radius, authority class, reviewer state, negative count, deployment flag, account or API-key flag, sibling-merge flag, and terminal verdict; require abstention whenever an exact prerequisite is absent.
boundary: No AGI, ASI, consciousness, sentience, personhood, enacted-law, deployment, exhaustive-security, complete-accessibility, production-readiness, Theory-of-Everything, proof or canon, empirical-confirmation, legal or cultural-ratification, or independent-team-reproduction claim is preregistered as achieved.
